quests.title: Seeds for Lincoln
quests.summary: A resident of Birmingham has saved seed for a gardener in Lincoln. Take it over and bring back the news.

steps.line: Ah, her beans! I've been waiting all winter. Tell her I've a bed ready and a very smug cat.

steps.text: Take the thanks back to Birmingham.
steps.line: Pleased as punch, was she? Good. Now I'll not have to carry them myself next year.

start.ask: Listen, I've saved a twist of seed for a fellow gardener in Lincoln. It's no weight at all. Would you carry it?
start.accept: Keep it dry. They're the best beans in the county, and I'll hear nothing against them.

quests.title: The Tune from Stoke-on-Trent
quests.summary: A resident of Lincoln half remembers a tune. Find someone in Stoke-on-Trent who knows how it ends.

steps.line: Dum-de-dum-dum... oh, that's 'The Cobbler's Wife'. It ends on the same note it starts. Tell them.

steps.text: Take the ending back to Lincoln.
steps.line: The same note! Of course it does! Thirty years I've been waiting. Thank you.

start.ask: Listen, I've a tune that stops halfway and it's driving me mad. Would you hum it to someone in Stoke-on-Trent? Someone musical.
start.accept: Dum-de-dum-dum. That's it. That's all I've got.
